capabilities.scope: Controlled functions/async, classes/methods, generic aliases, match syntax, decorators, malformed rejection, Unicode/CRLF/BOM and execution sentinel
Lexical declarations, parameters, ownership, closures, immutable aliases, unique local/imported direct calls and source-backed references
Literal root-local absolute/relative imports, explicit namespace/src roots, unique aliases/re-exports, bounded immutable literal __all__; external/missing/stub/excluded outcomes distinct
Module-local unique undecorated class bases and bounded C3 MRO; no dynamic receiver dispatch
Strict UTF-8/ASCII and optional UTF-8 BOM; original-byte SHA256, original UTF-16 half-open ranges; other encodings rejected
Repository execution/imports, monkey patching, reflection, dynamic imports, descriptor/attribute dispatch, arbitrary decorator targets, runtime path/environment discovery
Comprehension/lambda/loop/with/except/match binding scopes are explicit gaps and conservatively suppress module direct-call/export verification
Default/annotation expressions remain explicit boundaries; no guessed body-execution relationships
Conservative union of pinned Windows builtin/frozen inventories remains external; runtime finder/cache changes and disabling frozen modules are unqualified

qualificationPolicy: Pinned oracle versions qualify controlled syntax/static patterns only. Runtime repository capabilities remain python-unqualified/partial because the adapter does not infer an installed interpreter or exact environment from ranges. No language-wide, Django or model-domain badge is granted.
sourceRoots: One declared static environment per project; default project root, or explicit bounded root-local moduleRoots adapter input. No machine sys.path, .pth, editable-install hooks or setup.py execution.
